balls.text: around the stumps. Full on middle. Swings across the line and gets it to deep backward square leg. DK finishes on 53 and RCB score 196
like a tracer bullet! A 22-ball fifty! Madhwal bowls full and wide, and Karthik plays a sublime cover drive that just glides along the grass like a piece of flat stone on a lake. So fluid!
15 rows back! Madhwal thinks the short ball is a good option, but nope, Karthik has other ideas. Instinctively reacts to the length and then pummels a pull over square leg.

RCB touch 185! Full and wide ball, but Karthik was expecting that. Slashes hard at it, away from his body, and still gets it between the two fielders on the third man boundary! Somehow manages to beat both fielders
full and wide ball, beyond the tram-lines

high full toss outside off. DK flat-bats a mistimed shot to mid on and looks at the umpires for a no-ball call but there's none. He reviews with the desire of getting the decision overturned....but he does not succeed.
yorker attempted. Squirted away to the square for a single. Importantly brings Karthik back on strike

snap back to reality as DK lofts Bumrah's slot ball for a Nidahas Trophy style six over extra cover. Hits the boundary skirting on the full as RCB inch closer to 180. Bumrah finishes with regal figures of 5-21
yorker length ball on middle. Akash gets an inside edge to fine leg while getting the bat down

Five for the great man! Back of a length ball on an off-stump line. Cramps Vyshak up but that doesn't deter the batter from attempting a flat-batted shot. Mistimed to the man waiting at mid off. Rohit runs in to celebrate with Bumrah and simply bows at him to acknowledge this spell
short ball on off. Chauhan tries to pull but he's too late into the shot. Easy catch at midwicket as Bumrah gets his fourth
full ball just outside off. Chauhan tries to hit him over cover but can't get under it convincingly. Mistimed over David at mid off for a couple
around the stumps. Starts off with a short ball aimed at his head. Swings the bat but misses

deposited beyond fine leg! Short ball, only 118kph, and that's bread and butter for the man with the second-highest number of appearances in the IPL. Hangs back, lets the ball get to him and then pulls it over the man at fine leg
over the stumps. Back of a length ball angling across. Chauhan slices an aggressive shot over cover point for one
around the stumps to DK. Low full toss on his pads and he flicks it to deep fine leg. Was in DK's arc to flick it over square leg but he mistimed the shot
short of good length ball on leg. Pulled to deep backward square leg
full ball, wider outside leg. Misses the flick but gets the wide run

over the stumps to Chauhan, and bowls a low full toss slightly wide outside off. Chauhan slices a square drive, and breaks his wrists while playing the shot, sending it behind square through the off side
around the stumps to this batter. Yorker length ball outside off, can't get under it
yorker attempted again but ends up as a low full toss. Chauhan manages to flick it leg side for a single

Toe-crusherrrrrr! Around the stumps to Lomror, and of course he is welcomed by the yorker. The batter can't get his toe out, and the ball hits him straight on the toe. Umpire Menon says that's out, but Lomror reviews before getting low to see if his toe is fine. Replay confirms this would've clipped the outside of leg stump and Lomror walks out gingerly.

taken by David at long on! Attacks the ball by running in and then dives forward to take a low catch. Bumrah bowls a shin-high full toss on middle, and Du Plessis tries to clobber Bumrah over long on, but he just couldn't get the bat under enough to generate power through the shot. Still, gone for a very important 61
toe-ends a yorker-length ball to wide long on. A cutter

slower ball, very wide outside off. Du Plessis attempts a drive by reaching out but he misses. Ball goes to Kishan, who dives diagonally forward to pocket a low catch. RCB scurry across for a bye but Kishan thinks there's some bat there. Umpire Menon goes upstairs to check and the TV umpire says that is not out. MI couldn't have taken a review anyway since they have none
shin-high full toss on middle as Bumrah misses the yorker. Du Plessis chips a shot over the bowler's head down the ground and calls quickly for two

DK manages to beat the very fine fielder standing at deep third! Four boundaries this over in the same region and this time DK gets a thick outside edge that bounces past a diving Kishan. Tries to play away from his body to a full and fast ball outside off, but luck was on the batter's side
full and very wide. This time DK doesn't move to the off side. Takes the wide instead

another cheeky shot! Madhwal attempts a slower ball, full on off, but DK doesn't commit too early and opens the bat's face to guide it between Kishan the keeper and Coetzee short third! Kishan did have a chance of a catch, but the ball just eluded him
ramped again! Over the vacant slip region Madhwal attempts a yorker wide outside off. DK just brings the bat down and helps it along the way
yorker, very very wide outside off. Karthik moves way outside off too, to play some sort of a scoop over the leg side, but can't connect well. The shot hits his own body

first boundary for him in ten balls! Karthik was getting in position for a pre-meditated scoop over the leg side, it seems, but he spots a full toss outside off and therefore opts to open the bat's face before ramping it over the vacant slip region
full ball, bit wide outside off. Mistimes a shot towards cover for one
aiming for the wide yorker, ends up being an overpitched delivery outside the tram-lines. MI are reviewing the wide and that's a review wasted.
full ball outside off. Stays a shade low and goes straight through with Karthik trying to hit him across the line. Misses. Gopal is done with 1/32
length ball outside off. DK moves off side to play a paddle sweep. Misses, hits his pad. Impact outside off stump
chance of a catch! But falls a few metres short of Nabi at mid off. This was a half-tracker around off and turning  away. Du Plessis tried to flat-bat it over extra cover but toe-ended it
twenty rows back! Gopal floats a full ball and it lands on off. Bit of turn away with Du Plessis backing away. The extra room allows a beautiful flow of the bat and he clobbers it over long on
flatter ball. Fullish just outside off. turning in. DK swipes this across the line to deep midwicket
full ball just outside off. Skidding through. Cut to deep extra cover, slapping this in front of square

length ball pulled to deep square leg. Madhwal runs around the boundary line from deep backward square leg and puts in a dive to stop the four. The umpires will have a check as Tilak pats Madhwal's back for the effort
short ball, but not so quick. Pulled to deep midwicket and that's his 50! His 34th in IPL and 66th in all T20s.
moves to 49 with a lofted drive over cover. One-bounce four. Fullish ball just outside off and he leapt onto that opportunity in a flash. Not the right line and length with mid-off inside the circle
good length ball outside off, but with pace taken off. Cut to the deep
yorker length ball around leg stump. Clipped to deep fine leg after avoiding his toes getting crushed.
fullish ball around off, and he strikes a shot towards midwicket for one
full ball around off. Googly is driven to long on's right gently, allowing them to take a second run too. Time out
length ball on middle. Sharp turn in. Flicked to backward square leg for a single
length ball on off. Turning in. Karthik tries to flick it leg side but misses. No appeal this time since missing leg
starts off with a full ball on middle, and DK tries the reverse sweep. Misses the shot, hits his body. LBW appeal turned down. They do not review - did they think glove was involved?

is Maxwell gone cheaply again! Oh yes, Gopal! Maxwell does not even review. Gopal slows up a fullish ball around off stump. And the wrong'un turns in gently, not too much, and Maxwell's flicked this down the wrong line totally. Plumb LBW and that's his third duck of the season! Mumbai don't celebrate much, they notice Coetzee on the floor beyond the boundary line so Hardik and Gopal run towards him.
good length ball on middle. Turning into the batter. He moves leg side and then flicks it to deep midwicket
good length ball just outside off. A checked punch to cover
full ball just outside off and he drives one to mid off
short ball on leg and this is rising over his head once more
short ball on middle and leg. Maxwell half-ducks, and sees it go over.
welcomed with a back of a length ball on middle. Hits Maxwell near the armpit, hurried onto him

When the going gets tough, the tough get going! Bandana-wearing Coetzee runs in with fire, bangs it short, angles it in, and Patidar tries to pull. Gloved, and Kishan takes a simple one. Big roar from the South African and Patidar is fifty and out

fifty in style! Oh whattashot! Coetzee with a length ball around off and angling into middle. Patidar makes a bit of room and then flat-bats a pull in front of square, sending it towards wide long on again!
knee-high full toss flicked away! Coetzee searches for the yorker, misses, and Patidar uses his wrists to play a shot in front of square, over midwicket inside the circle
yorker ball on middle and leg. Patidar moves leg side and gets the bat down to jam the ball away to the off side
is that out? Mumbai review for caught behind. Short ball just outside off. Rises steeply as Patidar tries to fend from near his face. Big gap as ball goes past the bat to Kishan. Will stay not out
length ball around off. Pace off too. Bunted gently to cover where there's a gap for one
slower ball, on a good length outside off. Slapped to mid on, dragging the shot to the leg side from way outside off
short ball around off. Not very short, though, and Patidar could've ramped it over Kishan. He was thinking about it for sure but doesn't play it eventually
tries the yorker, ends up as a low full toss on middle. Driven to wide mid on for a single
slower ball, wide outside off but inside the tram-lines. Patidar plays a delicate late glance with the bat's face open, and forces a dive from backward point to slow the ball
another wide. Hardik bowling to his plan but not able to execute. Back of a length ball outside off, but outside the tram-lines
the cutter but it doesn't come off. Lands quite wide and goes away further

second tier! Pandya brings the line slightly closer to off stump, and the fuller ball needs no second invitation. Not very full but enough on this true surface to play an aggressive shot on the up. Over wide long on!
good length ball, sixth-stump line outside off. Patidar puts all his weight behind a cut but it is mistimed. Fielder at deep point slides around to keep it down to two
good length ball outside off and he clatters a cut to deep point on the boundary line
fullish ball outside off. Mistimed cut in front of square
cutter to start off. Length ball, fairly wide outside off. Faf is deceived while cutting. Misses
full ball on middle stump. This time the googly forces a mis-hit from Du Plessis, his attempted leg-side loft instead going towards wide long on
full ball on off. Another googly. Patidar tries the slog sweep again but this time his head falls over and he loses shape. Inside edged to short fine leg
Patidar has a strike rate of 202 against legspinners since 2012 and he is showing it why. Fighted full ball around off. Patidar gets low and with the turn muscles a slog over cow corner!
full ball bit wider outside off. Driven to point but can't beat the fielder
full ball, more air. Patidar tries to hammer it down the ground but the googly takes an inside edge to short fine leg
strikes this one towards long on for a single
smacked! Shepherd bowls a short pitched ball outside off but with pace off. Sits up comfortably for Patidar with enough width for the batter to free his arms. Clubbed over mid off

good length ball just outside off. Patidar swivels and quickly gets in position to drag a pull behind square. Madhwal runs around and slides near the boundary line at square leg to stop and throw it in
pace off ball, good length outside off. Du Plessis is through the cut too early, slicing it over point for one
gets another boundary away! Fullish ball, bit wide outside off. Du Plessis clears the front foot and clubs a shot through the off side, beating cover and also mid off!
good length ball on middle, and Patidar misses the flick. Hits his pad in front of the stumps but height will save Patidar. They scurry across for one
back of a length ball around off. Du Plessis swipes a shot across his chest to deep square leg
flighted ball just outside off. Clatters a shot to long off where there's protection. Ten off that
fullish ball around off. Flicked to deep backward square leg for a couple more
tossed up, extra flight. Googly is struck to Tilak at deep square leg. They call for two, but Tilak's throw to Gopal is strong. And Patidar survives with the dive, but didn't need to
full ball on off and he flicks it to fine leg for a walking single

a rare three at the Wankhede but that's because of overthrows. Du Plessis punches a length ball through the covers. Nabi from long off cuts it off but his throw to the stumps is a direct-hit at Kishan. Inadvertent.
good length ball on off. Googly flicked to deep backward square leg for a single
Slot ball on off. Du Plessis stays leg-side of the ball and then lofts a shot over mid off! Slightly toe-ended but enough to clear mid off. Powerplay done at 44/2
full ball around off stump and drilled to mid off. Fielder gets behind that to intercept
good length ball around off. Du Plessis backs away trying to swipe a shot over the leg side but he ends up inside-edging the shot onto his....you know what. Ouch!
good length ball around off stump. Punchy shot to cover for a single
put away smartly! Good length ball around off with true bounce onto Patidar. He stays deep in his crease before swiveling and pulling over the fielder at midwicket
good length ball around off and he tucks the batter up for a defensive shot
out next ball? Full ball around off and middle. Du Plessis tries to drive but the ball jags in, flicks his thighs before going to Kishan. They appealed for caught-behind but no
deposited! Good length ball, bit more width, Patidar makes a bit of room, and flat-bats a shot over mid-off! Du Plessis connecting them well
short of good length ball just outside off. Patidar does well to scythe a cut from an awkward high position, but an excellent effort at point from Gopal stops the ball
short ball around off, and Patidar chooses to duck under it. Quickly goes to Kishan who takes it behind leg side
short of good length ball around off. Patidar tries to glance it with the bat's open face to the off side but it takes an inside edge to the leg side
overpitched ball outside off. Patidar gets his bat close to the ball to drive square but misses making any connection
good length ball just outside off. Stands tall and punches to deep point for a single
fullish ball on middle and leg, and Patidar makes full use of the ball drifting into his pads. Flicked past short fine leg inside the circle, who put in a dive
Jacks has to go! Can't clear mid-on as he tries to flat-bat a short-ish ball. Madhwal is a skiddy customer, that is his thing and he has come onto Jacks a tad quicker than the batter expected
fullish ball around off. Jacks clatters a drive towards mid off. Superb timing, but to the fielder
full ball on middle. Jacks lifts it gloriously over midwicket, sending it to the boundary with disdain! Slot ball and Jacks taking a leg-side stance gets under it easily
good length ball just outside off. Guided to deep third
masterful comeback ball. Good length ball just outside off but with the pace taken off. Jacks with adrenaline high tries to slap it through the off side, but misses. On the bounce to the keeper
full ball on his toes and he smartly clips it, getting it behind between the fine leg fielder and the deep square leg fielder! Expertly finds the gap
overpitched ball, outside off. Jacks tries to drive but misses

Big man gets big man! Blockbuster stuff. Length ball around off but Bumrah gets it into Kohli with his wide release angle. Kohli looks to counterattack by swiping a shot to the leg side but the ball kisses his bat before going behind. Kishan dives to his left and pouches it

LBW appeal! Given not out. Full ball on middle but swinging into leg. Kohli is a tad slow to get forward and play a drive through midwicket, and instead finds the ball hitting his leg. Would've slid down leg stump
short of good length ball around off. Kohli clatters a flat-batted shot to midwicket, but can't beat the fielder
what a response! Good length ball around off but the line became predictable. Du Plessis shuffles to the off side, gets in position for a scoop, and helps the ball along its way over fine leg!
jags in sharply and hits du Plessis. This is roughly 145kph, on a good length around off but comes in sharply after pitching, thudding the batter's pads.
full ball just outside off and a compact drive to short cover
finally gets bat on ball off Coetzee, but still mistimed. full ball just outside off. He tries to push a drive to mid off but hits the inside of the bat. Rolls away to mid on
good length ball, slightly closer to the stumps. Kohli tries to swipe a checked pull to the leg side but he's beaten again
good length ball on a fifth-stump line. He tries to hammer a cut square but misses. Through to Kishan
the extra room helps him free his arms! Du Plessis backs away a bit as Nabi bowls a length ball outside off. Enough room created to slap a four in front of square, beating cover too!
full ball on middle and leg. Guided with the turn to backward square leg for one
full ball on off. Drifts in and lands near his toes. Driven down the ground for another single
full on off. Bit of turn in, and flicked to square leg for a single
off the mark with a single. A full-flourish drive to long on after taking a big stride forward
length ball just outside off. Kohli gently guides it to short third

What a shot to end things by captain Hardik! Was a full ball outside off, he goes back and across and carves it over deep cover. Mumbai have given RCB a proper hammering. They have chased down 197 in 15.3 overs. That will give their NRR a much-needed boost.
Yorker on off stump, he digs it past the bowler
A full toss again, how many of these have we seen tonight? Just below waist high outside off. He opens up the off side and sends it racing past extra cover
Short of a length ball on Tilak's hips who swivels and pulls to deep backward square leg
Misses out. Fuller in length outside off. He looks to force the drive outside off. Can't make a connection.
Another four! On-pace back of a length ball outside off, he hacks the pull in the vacant wide long-on area.
beaten by the lack of pace. Slower back of a length ball angling across the batter, who eyes the pull but is early into it
Juuust short of long off. Length ball outside off, he flat-bats it to the Prabudessai who was sprinting in. But he can't reach it
Low full toss outside off, he drives to deep cover
Slower back of a length ball outside off, he thrashes the cut to deep point
Fuller outside off, he drives to extra cover
Edged and four. The luck going Tilak's way.  Was a back of a length ball on leg stump. He was looking to pull it away,  gets a thick under-edge past the keeper

He's found the fielder. Was the height of the ball okay, though? Yep, it was. Very close, but just about alright. A full toss just below Surya's waist outside off. He scythes it but straight to deep point who takes a comfortable catch. A sensational knock from Surya comes to an end.
Misses out this time. On-pace length ball just outside off. He looks to go hard at it, loses his shape and drags the ball to deep midwicket
Hardik gets into the act now. Slower ball but that was right in the slot for the batter, who clears his front leg and muscles him over long off
A dot ball....what! Fuller, angling across from Surya, who can't get a bat on that

Four more and Suryakumar  Yadav races to his fifty off 17 balls! Slower back of a length ball on off, he pulls him over midwicket. There is no fielder in the deep there. 22nd IPL fifty for Surya, this is the fastest of the lot

And now that inside-the-line scoop from Surya. Slower length ball well outside off, he gets across, bends down on one knee and scoops this over short fine. The angles that Surya creates are sometimes beyond believable. He is striking at 300!

Oh, dear me. I am running out of adjectives to describe Surya tonight. On a length outside off. Was an on-pace ball. Surya, once again carves him over deep point. All wrist-work there and some amazing bat speed..
Goes for that scoop, but can't connect. Length ball well outside off, he gets right across but Topley angled that well outside off
Oh, what a shot Surya! Fuller ball well outside off, he generates amazing back speed to carve it over point.
Flatter on the stumps, he pushes to long-on
In the gap to the right of short third. Was a tossed up full ball well outside off. He gets a thick outside edge and finds the gap
Angled into Pandya on middle and leg, he pushes to long-off
And he is away first ball! Tossed up well outside off, he gets forward and absolutely smokes it over long-on

Topley has taken an absolute stunner! Oh, my word! Catch of the tournament anyone? Fuller on middle and leg. Rohit slams the sweep, gets a good chunk on it, but Topley flings to his left, one hand out and plucks out a worldie of a catch.
Short on middle and leg, he hops back and hammers the pull to the left of deep backward square leg
Wohoo! Surya is in the house! A rank  knee-high full toss on his pads. He gets across a touch and smokes him miles, miles over deep backward square leg
And the Supla shot comes out! The crowd has come to watch Surya and they are getting their money worth. Was on a length outside off, he gets across and just picks it over deep backward square leg

Dropped by Maxwell at backward point! Was short and wide, he absolutely thrashes the cut to Maxwell, who can't hold on. That was travelling at the speed of knots. He winces in pain and is off the ground too.
Picked away for a huge six! Slower knuckle ball that was on a length. The ball just sat up for Surya to stay back and pump him over deep midwicket
A length ball angling sharply back into Surya on off, who defends towards cover
Whisked away with some pristine wrist-work.  On a length outside off, he gets it to the left of deep midwicket, who can only get a hand to it, but can't prevent the four
Chipped to long-on. Knuckle ball on off stump, he tips it without much control but checked his shot.
Pinpoint yorker on off stump, he can only jam it towards point
Knuckle ball outside off, was on the shorter side. Surya gets across and fetches the pull to the left of deep backward square leg for a couple of runs
Fuller on off, he flicks it neatly to the left of Kohli at deep midwicket, who sprints across like a gazelle and prevents a second run
Pulled, just over Topley at short fine leg. He got a hand to it, but that wasn't enough. Slower bouncer around shoulder-high. Got enough height to clear one of the tallest fielders on the ground
Another slower knuckle ball from Vyshak. Was on a length on off stump. He defends back to the bowler
Fuller on middle and leg, he works it in to the left of deep backward square leg for a couple of runs to get off the mark
RCB have a wicket...finally! Akash Deep gets them the breakthrough. Slower bouncer on off stump. Kishan flat bats it without much timing and Kohli completes a simple catch at long-off
Good length ball outside off, he stays back and guides with an open face to deep third
Slower bouncer, but that is over Rohit's head. Called a wide. The 100 is up in 8.3 overs for MI.
Banged in short into Kishan's body. He swivels and pulls to deep midwicket on the bounce
Another poor ball, another dispatch! Knee-high full toss on off. He tonks this in the region over wide long-on. Doing this easy, these two
Fuller on off stump, he mistimes his drive towards mid-off
Flatter length ball on middle and leg, he clips it to deep midwicket
Down the track and goes straight over the bowler's head. An 87kph length ball on middle and leg. He jumps down and thrashes him for a one-bounce four
Drags his length back just a touch seeing Kishan come down. He adjusts and taps him to point
A touch flatter on a length at 92.4kph on the pads. He works it to deep backward square leg
Floated on leg stump, he gets forward and pushes to long on
Tossed up outside off, he leans forward and laces the drive to deep cover
Fuller in length outside off, he plays with an open face of the blade to the right of point for a quick run
Edged but there is no slip. Rohit gets four more, but that really should have been a wicket. Length ball outside off. He prods at it, and gets a thick edge past the keeper.
Juicy full toss over the right knee, and Rohit says thank you, very much! Knuckle ball goes wrong and Rohit simply hammers him over deep midwicket
Slower back of a length ball that continues to angle away from Rohit. He can't get enough timing on his cut to point
Nice, good yorker just outside off. He somehow digs it out
Starts with a slower back of a length ball on off, he scythes it to the left of deep midwicket for a run
Length on middle, he opens up and drives towards mid-off for a quick run
Again, this time for four. Length ball on off, but Kishan is camped on the back foot and he thumps him to the right of mid-off

A 23-ball fifty for Kishan! What striking this is. Just a tad short on off stump but Kishan is so quick it to hop back and pummel this over mid-on and eventually over the ropes. Clean striking by the MI opener.
Quicker length ball on off stump, he stays back and works it to wide long-on. Kohli is on to the ball in a flash
Fuller, flatter outside off, he drives to deep cover
Drags the ball short on middle stump, Kishan rocks back and hammers the  pull over midwicket
A dot ball to end the over. Was fuller in length well outside off. Rohit was trying to glide that away fine, misses. 23 off that over, nevertheless

Picked away, this time by Rohit! That was such an effortless shot by him. Full on off stump, angling into Rohit who just whistles this one away over in the region between deep square leg and deep midwicket
Saves a certain four there Lomror. Siraj goes full outside off, Kishan drives straight back but Lomror hares across from mid-on and puts in a full-length dive to his left
6, 4, 6 for Kishan! Shot of the evening for me. Short of a length ball on middle, Kishan backs away, leans back then and slashes him with disdain over deep point
A punch off the back foot now! Another back of a length ball angling across Kishan who thrashes it through covers. The lightning outfield does the rest.
Back of a length ball on middle. Kishan swivels and pulls over deep backward square leg. Didn't get it entirely off the middle of the bat, but enough to send it into the crowd

Top-edge that goes sailing into the crowd. Short of a length ball on middle and leg, Rohit shapes up for a pull, gets a top edge that balloons straight over the keeper's head and flies into the stands
Excellent stop by Jacks at backward point. Fuller outside off, he slices it to the right of Jacks, who makes a one-handed stop
On a length on Rohit's pads, he gets across and flicks it to the right of midwicket.
Gets away with that. Back of a length ball down leg. Rohit looks to help it away and misses. Called a wide with DK getting across to his left
On a length just outside off, he pushes towards backward point
Goes for the pull but misses. Back of a length ball well outside off and continuing to shape away. Rohit can't lay a bat on it
Skids the length ball sharply back into Rohit around off stump. He is right behind it and defends. Certainly some movement for Akash
Fuller length ball on middle again, Kishan drives to mid-off.
Rohit backs away but Topley goes yorker length on middle and the batter can only dig it out towards backward point
On a length on middle and leg, he works it to deep square leg for a run
Too straight and punished. Length on the pads, he flicks it imperiously over midwicket

Edged and Maxwell can't hold on to it at slip. Full, shaping away from Kishan, who gets a thick edge, but there is a gap between DK and Maxwell and the ball goes between them. Maxwell throws his right hand but the ball was always going away
Flayed away for four! Gets the ball fuller with the ball shaping away from Kishan. He throws his hands at it and slices over backward point. Deep point can't get to his left quick enough
Full veering in on off stump. Rohit prods forward with a full face of the bat and defends
Good length ball outside off, he opens the face of the bat and guides to deep point
Huge appeal from Siraj, but not given. Was a length ball on leg stump that Kishan missed and was struck on the pad, but think the ball pitched outside leg
BANG! Full and on Kishan's pads, was there to be hit and the batter cashes in. Flicks it miles over deep backward square leg
Full and continuing to swing away from Kishan well outside off. DK leaps across to his left and grabs it one-handed. Not called a wide. Think this one was.
Fuller and well outside off, Kishan mistimes to mid-off
Oh, the inside-edge saves him. Full, swinging sharply back into Rohit who looks to flay it away and if not for that slight inside-edge onto the pad was a goner.
Fuller outside off, he scythes it away to deep point
Left alone. Length ball with a hint of nibble around the seventh stump.
Lovely drive but straight to backward point. Fuller-length ball outside off, he gets the ball to shape away from Kishan, who plays the square drive
Goes fuller in length outside off. Kishan reaches for it and drives towards cover point with an open face of the bat
